title: cli: docs/nav-target never judges a package body's navigationContributions on a multi-package preserve artifact, so a dead doc target there builds clean
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK
Filing gate: ① a product defect with a measurement. The #27210 implementer found it (os-dev-report `6480884619` on #27210, `out_of_scope_findings[0]`, class a). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3 (`session_01Utp6CXc5hequf76uJfzrdK`). ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage.

## Symptom

`os build` / `os validate` / `os lint` reach `lintDocNavTargets` (`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`) through `collectAndLintDocs`. It reads `manifest.navigationContributions` off the artifact's top-level manifest only. On a `composeStacks(…, { manifest: 'preserve' })` artifact, a non-owner package's contributions live in its package body, so they are never judged.

Measured by the implementer:

- single-package stack with `navigationContributions: [{ app: 'setup', items: [{ type: 'doc', doc: 'ghost_doc' }] }]` → one `docs/nav-target` issue at `apps/setup/navigation/nav_help`;
- the same contribution on the first (non-owner) package of a two-package preserve composition → **none**: the top-level manifest has no `navigationContributions`, the body has them.

The cli census (`normalized-call-sites.test.ts`) cannot see it: it is a member chain off the manifest envelope key.

## Expected

The same reach PR #27342 (#27210) gives the `apps` walk: judge the top level's contributions when present, otherwise each package body's (`artifactPackages`), so a dead doc target in a contributed nav item is refused on a multi-package artifact as it is on a single-package one. Note this newly refuses a shape that builds clean today (a narrowing, as #27204 and #27342 declare).

## Filing facts

- reach: any multi-package preserve artifact whose non-owner package contributes navigation to another app.
- Dedupe: searched "navigationContributions package body nav-target preserve artifact lintDocNavTargets not judged". Neighbours: #18203 (closed, the i18n lint reading `apps[].navigation` only), #16507 (closed, comments on `navigationContributions[].group`). Neither covers nav-target on a package body's contributions.
- Dedupe words: navigationContributions package body nav-target; preserve artifact contributions unjudged; lintDocNavTargets manifest only.
